memory_update.text: SPSC is the highest-priority pure-play candidate for retail supplier networks, EDI, retailer compliance, and supplier workflow plumbing; keep in the underfollowed lane for Layer 2 evidence work.
DSGX is a credible second-order B2B connectivity/logistics-network candidate, but retail exposure must be separated from broader transportation, customs, and logistics software revenue.

node: Retail supplier networks, EDI, order-management, catalog, compliance, and replenishment plumbing
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the retail supplier-network plumbing node. The cleanest direct exposure is SPS Commerce: a mid-cap retail network/EDI SaaS company with recurring-revenue customers, trading-partner integrations, retailer compliance logic, and direct exposure to Walmart/Amazon/Target-style supplier workflows. Descartes and OpenText provide broader B2B/EDI networks but retail is diluted inside larger logistics or information-management platforms. Manhattan Associates is a reference/order-management leader with strong retail OMS/WMS relevance, but it is more of an omnichannel fulfillment platform than a supplier-network pure play. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
